body: OWNER DIRECTION, 2026-08-31: do not hold the local Sherlock scientific vertical on absence of a redistribution licence. Intended use is local scientific analysis only; source media, annotation, and participant bytes will not be redistributed. The owner asserts fair use as the basis and points to Chen et al. 2017, DOI 10.1038/nn.4450, as prior scientific use of the Sherlock viewing/free-recall material. This records the owners scope and asserted basis; it is not a claim that fair use is a licence or a legal adjudication. Section 107 names research as a use that may qualify, but the Copyright Office describes fair use as case-specific under four factors. Requested governance disposition: replace the licence-plus-redistribution hold with a recorded local-use-only basis and an explicit no-redistribution prohibition. Keep participant-source authority, lineage and alias receipts, source identity/timebase, semantic authority, and scientific anti-circularity gates independent. Chief and Sherlock intake: please route a bounded court/ADR amendment and remove only the license-based local-analysis block; do not infer permission to vendor, upload, publish source bytes, or remotely process them.
